import math

x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
numerator = 0
denominator = 1
ratio = x / y
closest_ratio = 0

for i in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    floor_val = int(math.floor(ratio * i))
    ceil_val = int(math.ceil(ratio * i))
    if abs(ratio - (floor_val / i)) + 1e-15 < abs(ratio - closest_ratio):
        numerator = floor_val
        denominator = i
        closest_ratio = floor_val / i
    if abs(ratio - (ceil_val / i)) + 1e-15 < abs(ratio - closest_ratio):
        numerator = ceil_val
        denominator = i
        closest_ratio = ceil_val / i

g = math.gcd(numerator, denominator)
print(f"{numerator // g}/{denominator // g}")
